entries.english: Welcome to the world of Mu.;We have been waiting for a hero like you to arrive and put a stop to the chaos brought on to the Mu realm by Kundun.
entries.zh-CN: 欢迎来到奇迹世界。;我们一直等待像你这样的勇士，终结昆顿给奇迹大陆带来的混乱。

entries.english: Continue listening.
entries.zh-CN: 继续听下去。

entries.english: However, journeys such as this are bound to be perilous.;If you wish, we can provide you with a simple tutorial. What do you say?
entries.zh-CN: 然而，这样的旅程必定充满危险。;如果你愿意，我们可以提供简单的新手教学。你意下如何？

entries.english: A tutorial?;I look forward to it!
entries.zh-CN: 新手教学？;我很期待！

entries.english: Tutorials are for children. Turn down the offer.
entries.zh-CN: 新手教学是给孩子的。拒绝帮助。

entries.english: It won't take up too much of your time. I'll simply explain basic controls and hunting techniques.;Are you sure you don't want our help?
entries.zh-CN: 不会占用你太多时间。我只会简单介绍基本操作和打怪技巧。;你确定不需要我们的帮助吗？

entries.english: I have plenty of experience.;To each his own!
entries.zh-CN: 我已经很有经验了。;每个人都有自己的选择！

entries.english: How can I turn him down...?;Alright, let's give it a try!
entries.zh-CN: 怎能拒绝他的好意呢……;好吧，试试看！

entries.english: I'm glad we can help. We aren't difficult to find.;Simply look for and talk to the Shadow Phantom Soldier in any of the towns.
entries.zh-CN: 很高兴能够帮到你。我们并不难找。;在各个城镇找到幻影导师，与他交谈即可。

entries.english: I regret we can't be of any help to you.;Here, at least take this present. I hope, the next time we meet, a great warrior stands before my eyes.;Enjoy your time out there.
entries.zh-CN: 很遗憾没能帮到你。;至少请收下这份礼物。希望下次见面时，你已成为一名出色的勇士。;祝你旅途愉快。

entries.english: I respect your decision to go on this journey.;Allow me to teach you a few simple but essential things you need to know before your adventure in MU begins.
entries.zh-CN: 我尊重你踏上旅程的决定。;在奇迹冒险开始前，让我教你一些简单却必不可少的知识。

entries.english: ...This is Noria, the kingdom of Elves! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!
entries.zh-CN: ……这里是弓箭手的王国仙踪林！我的冒险就从这里开始。;真令人兴奋！

entries.english: ...This is Lorencia, the kingdom of Dark Wizards and Dark Knights! So this is where my adventure begins.;Excellent! My adventure begins!
entries.zh-CN: ……这里是魔法师与剑士的王国勇者大陆！我的冒险就从这里开始。;太好了！冒险开始了！

entries.english: ...This is Elveland, the kingdom of Summoners! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!
entries.zh-CN: ……这里是召唤术师的王国幻术园！我的冒险就从这里开始。;真令人兴奋！

entries.english: It's nice to meet you.;May I ask who you are?
entries.zh-CN: 很高兴认识你。;请问你是谁？

entries.english: Alright! Let's get started with the tutorial.
entries.zh-CN: 好！让我们开始新手教学吧。

entries.english: Let's start with something simple.;Close your quest window and either press C or click on the Character (C) button located on the bottom right of your screen to launch the Character Stats window.
entries.zh-CN: 先从简单的操作开始。;关闭任务窗口，按 C 键或点击屏幕右下方的角色（C）按钮，打开角色属性窗口。

entries.english: Now, press the I button or click on the Inventory (I/V) button located on the bottom right to open your Inventory window.
entries.zh-CN: 现在按 I 键，或点击屏幕右下方的背包（I/V）按钮，打开背包窗口。

entries.english: Press Q, W, E to use the items such as healing potion, mana potion, antidote, alcohol or town portal scroll registered under those keys.
entries.zh-CN: 按 Q、W、E 键，可使用绑定在对应快捷键上的治疗药水、魔法药水、解毒剂、酒或回城卷轴。

entries.english: Vault usage fee is deducted from your inventory according to your level.
entries.zh-CN: 使用仓库的费用根据角色等级从背包中扣除。

entries.english: Use the lock function on your vault to protect it.
entries.zh-CN: 使用仓库上锁功能保护你的物品。

entries.english: Point the cursor on the skill button and press ctrl+number key to set hotkey.
entries.zh-CN: 将鼠标移到技能按钮上，按 Ctrl＋数字键设置快捷键。

entries.english: Press space bar to collect loot.
entries.zh-CN: 按空格键拾取物品。

entries.english: To combat normally, left click on monster.
entries.zh-CN: 鼠标左键点击怪物进行普通攻击。

entries.english: To use skill during combat, right click on monster.
entries.zh-CN: 鼠标右键点击怪物施放技能。

entries.english: Right click on scrolls or orbs to master the noted skills.
entries.zh-CN: 鼠标右键点击技能卷轴或技能石，即可学习对应技能。

entries.english: To use skills or magic, right click on monster.
entries.zh-CN: 鼠标右键点击怪物，使用技能或魔法。

entries.english: The command (trade, party, whisper, etc.) system is accessible by pressing the 'D' key.
entries.zh-CN: 按 D 键打开指令菜单，可使用交易、组队、密语等功能。

entries.english: Click shortcut key T to check the quest information.
entries.zh-CN: 按 T 键查看任务信息。

entries.english: Wearing a level +5 or above boots allows you to run.
entries.zh-CN: 穿戴强化等级为 +5 或以上的靴子即可奔跑。

entries.english: When poisoned, you can cure yourself by using the antidote.
entries.zh-CN: 中毒后可使用解毒剂解除中毒。

entries.english: Using the 'town portal scroll' will transport you to the nearest town or safe area.
entries.zh-CN: 使用回城卷轴可返回最近的城镇或安全区。

entries.english: To save a screenshot in your Mu folder, press the 'Print Screen' key.
entries.zh-CN: 按 Print Screen 键截图，图片将保存在奇迹客户端目录中。

entries.english: Item's performance level decreases when the durability decreases.
entries.zh-CN: 物品耐久度降低时，其性能也会下降。

entries.english: To use the saved chatting macro, press Alt+number.
entries.zh-CN: 按 Alt＋数字键使用已保存的聊天宏。

entries.english: To fix your weapon or armor, go to the weapon merchants in town.
entries.zh-CN: 前往城镇的武器商人处修理武器或防具。

entries.english: The supplementary magic of the Elf can be used by clicking the name in the party window.
entries.zh-CN: 点击组队窗口中的角色名称，可对其施放弓箭手的辅助魔法。

entries.english: Click shortcut key T to check the quest information.
entries.zh-CN: 按 T 键查看任务信息。

entries.english: I'm sure you are well aware of Kundun. The weakest and most disorganized monsters of Kundun's army are frequently attacking and plundering civilians just outside of town. I wanted to ask you to eliminate these plundering monsters.... Will you accept this quest? (Level 15-25)
entries.zh-CN: 你一定听说过昆顿吧。昆顿军中最弱小、最散乱的怪物经常在城外袭击和抢掠平民。我想请你消灭这些劫掠者……你愿意接受这个任务吗？（等级15-25）

entries.english: Dispose of the Town Plunderers!
entries.zh-CN: 消灭城外的劫掠者！

entries.english: Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. My name is Olga. My fellow comrades from the Shadow Phantom Guardians and I serve Erin Gustiv, the queen of Noria.
entries.zh-CN: 啊，还没自我介绍。我叫 Olga。我和幻影守护者的同伴们共同效忠于仙踪林女王 Erin Gustiv。

entries.english: ...Shadow Phantom?;Guardians of the queen?
entries.zh-CN: ……幻影守护者？;女王的卫士？

entries.english: What are the queen's guardians doing at a place like this?
entries.zh-CN: 女王的卫士为什么会在这里？

entries.english: The queen's orders are to help those warriors starting out on their journey so that they can at least defend themselves against the forces of Kundun.
entries.zh-CN: 女王命我们帮助初出茅庐的勇士，让他们至少能够抵御昆顿的势力，保护自己。

entries.english: ...I'm moved that the queen has made such orders.
entries.zh-CN: ……女王竟有这样的命令，真令人感动。

entries.english: How will you help, exactly?
entries.zh-CN: 你们具体会怎样帮助我？

entries.english: I will teach you basic hunting and controls through a simple tutorial.;It's not that difficult, and I'm sure you'll finish it in no time.
entries.zh-CN: 我会通过简单的新手教学，教你基本操作和打怪技巧。;并不难，相信你很快就能学会。

entries.english: Great! I'll finish this tutorial in no time!
entries.zh-CN: 太好了！我一定很快就能完成教学！

entries.english: Excellent! Let's get started with the tutorial.
entries.zh-CN: 很好！让我们开始新手教学吧。

entries.english: The elder says Spiders are spinning webs on the outer walls of the town and has asked us to take care of them. Although the request was made to the Shadow Phantom Guardians, I believe the job is suitable for travelers who are just starting out on their journey. Will you accept this quest? (Level 1-14)
entries.zh-CN: 长老说，蜘蛛在城镇外墙上结网，请我们处理。虽然委托交给了幻影守护者，但我觉得这份工作很适合刚踏上旅程的冒险者。你愿意接受这个任务吗？（等级1-14）

entries.english: It sounds like an easy job...
entries.zh-CN: 听起来很容易……

entries.english: I accept your quest. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我接受你的委托。（接受）

entries.english: Hunting down measly Spiders is beneath me. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 区区蜘蛛，不值得我出手。（拒绝）

entries.english: That's unfortunate. You shouldn't pass this up if you want fast growth.... Come see me again before you reach level 15 if you want to accept the quest. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾。如果想快速成长，就不该错过这次机会……若改变主意，记得在达到15级之前回来找我。（任务已取消）

entries.english: Hunt down 10 Spiders from around town, and I'll give you a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭城镇周围的10只蜘蛛，回来后我会给你奖励。

entries.english: Plunderers...
entries.zh-CN: 劫掠者……

entries.english: I accept your quest. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我接受你的委托。（接受）

entries.english: Plunderers are too much for me to handle. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 这些劫掠者不是我能对付的。（拒绝）

entries.english: That's unfortunate. You shouldn't pass up on this if you want fast growth.... Come see me again before you reach level 26 if you want to accept the request. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾。如果想快速成长，就不该错过这次机会……若改变主意，记得在达到26级之前回来找我。（任务已取消）

entries.english: Defeat 15 Giants from near the Devias entrance (22, 45) on the east side of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只巨人。它们位于城镇东侧通往冰风谷的入口（22, 45）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Defeat 15 Liches from near the Dungeon entrance (159, 205) on the southwest side of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只黑巫师。它们位于城镇西南侧地下城入口（159, 205）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Defeat 15 Agons from near the south side (173, 222) of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只亚昆。它们位于城镇南侧（173, 222）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Defeat 15 Polluted Butterflies from near the tombstone (121, 156) on the north side of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只 Polluted Butterfly。它们位于城镇北侧墓碑（121, 156）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Our reconnaissance party reports that stolen supplies are being sent to Kundun's army. Please defeat the monsters controlling these plunderers while we ascertain the location of the supply route. Will you accept this quest? (Level 26-35)
entries.zh-CN: 侦察队报告，遭劫掠的物资正被运往昆顿军队。我们查明运输路线期间，请你消灭指挥这些劫掠者的怪物。你愿意接受这个任务吗？（等级26-35）

entries.english: Things are becoming serious....
entries.zh-CN: 事情越来越严重了……

entries.english: I accept your quest. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我接受你的委托。（接受）

entries.english: I don't have the time. I'm sorry. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 对不起，我没有时间。（拒绝）

entries.english: That's unfortunate. You shouldn't pass up on this if you want fast growth.... Come see me again before you reach level 36 if you want to accept the request. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾。如果想快速成长，就不该错过这次机会……若改变主意，记得在达到36级之前回来找我。（任务已取消）

entries.english: Defeat 20 Skeleton Warriors from near the Dungeon entrance (123, 227) on the southwest side of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭20只骷髅战士。它们位于城镇西南侧地下城入口（123, 227）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Defeat 20 Giants from near the Devias entrance (22, 45) on the east side of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭20只巨人。它们位于城镇东侧通往冰风谷的入口（22, 45）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Defeat 20 Stone Golems from near the southwest side (30, 214) of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭20只石巨人。它们位于城镇西南侧（30, 214）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: The town's Shadow Phantom Soldier is looking for someone he can rely on to carry out quests both big and small. Go see the Shadow Phantom Soldier again.
entries.zh-CN: 城里的幻影导师正在寻找可靠的人，帮助处理大小委托。请再去见见他。

entries.zh-CN: 消灭10只蜘蛛后，返回幻影导师处。
